title: Conditional loss of CaMKK2 in Osterix-positive osteoprogenitors enhances osteoblast function in a sex-divergent manner.
authors: Mattingly, Brett T; Kambrath, Anuradha Valiya; Ding, Xinchun; Thompson, William R; Sankar, Uma
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CaMKK2在成骨前体细胞中的条件性敲除对骨代谢的性别差异影响，属纯湿实验生物学，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ca(2+)/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase kinase 2 (CaMKK2) is a multi-functional, serine/threonine protein kinase with predominant roles in inflammation, systemic energy metabolism, and bone remodeling. We previously reported that global ablation of CaMKK2 or its systemic pharmacological inhibition led to bone mass accrual in mice by stimulating osteoblasts and inhibiting osteoclasts. However, a direct, cell-intrinsic role for the kinase in the osteoblast lineage has not been established. Here we report that conditional deletion of CaMKK2 from osteoprogenitors, using the Osterix 1 (Osx1) - GFP::Cre (tetracycline-off) mouse line, resulted in increased trabecular bone mass due to an acute stimulation of osteoblast function in male and female mice. The acute simulation of osteoblasts and bone formation following conditional ablation of osteoprogenitor-derived CaMKK2 was sustained only in female mice. Periosteal bone formation at the cortical bone was enhanced only in male conditional knockout mice without altering cortical bone mass or strength. Prolonged deletion of CaMKK2 in early osteoblasts was accompanied by a stimulation of osteoclasts in both sexes, indicating a coupling effect. Notably, alterations in trabecular and cortical bone mass were absent in the doxycycline-removed "Cre-only" Osx1-GFP::Cre mice. Thus, the increase in osteoblast function at the trabecular and cortical bone surfaces following the conditional deletion of CaMKK2 in osteoprogenitors is indicative of a direct but sex-divergent role for the kinase in osteoblasts.
abstract_zh: Ca(2+)/钙调蛋白依赖性蛋白激酶激酶2（CaMKK2）是一种多功能丝氨酸/苏氨酸蛋白激酶，在炎症、全身能量代谢和骨重塑中发挥主要作用。我们此前报道，全身性敲除CaMKK2或其系统性药理学抑制，通过刺激成骨细胞和抑制破骨细胞，导致小鼠骨量增加。然而，该激酶在成骨细胞谱系中直接的、细胞内在作用尚未确立。在此，我们报道，使用Osterix 1（Osx1）-GFP::Cre（四环素关闭）小鼠系，从成骨祖细胞中条件性删除CaMKK2，导致雄性和雌性小鼠小梁骨量增加，这是由成骨细胞功能的急性刺激所致。成骨祖细胞来源的CaMKK2条件性敲除后，成骨细胞和骨形成的急性刺激仅在雌性小鼠中持续存在。皮质骨处的骨膜骨形成仅在雄性条件性敲除小鼠中增强，而未改变皮质骨量或强度。在早期成骨细胞中长期删除CaMKK2，伴随两性中破骨细胞的刺激，表明存在偶联效应。值得注意的是，在多西环素移除的“仅Cre”Osx1-GFP::Cre小鼠中，小梁和皮质骨量的改变缺失。因此，成骨祖细胞中条件性删除CaMKK2后，小梁和皮质骨表面成骨细胞功能的增加，表明该激酶在成骨细胞中具有直接但性别分化的作用。
